import unittest
from solution import dispatch_event


class DispatchEventTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_calls_matching_handler_once_and_returns_result(self):
        calls = []

        def handler(event):
            calls.append(event)
            return {"accepted": event["value"]}

        event = {"kind": "save", "value": 3}
        handlers = {"save": handler}
        self.assertEqual(dispatch_event(event, handlers), {"accepted": 3})
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
        self.assertEqual(calls[0], event)
        self.assertIsNot(calls[0], event)
        self.assertIs(handlers["save"], handler)

    def test_handler_receives_deep_copy(self):
        event = {"kind": "change", "nested": {"items": [1]}}

        def handler(received):
            received["kind"] = "mutated"
            received["nested"]["items"].append(2)
            return None

        self.assertIsNone(dispatch_event(event, {"change": handler}))
        self.assertEqual(event, {"kind": "change", "nested": {"items": [1]}})

    def test_handler_result_is_deep_copied(self):
        owned = {"nested": [1]}

        def handler(event):
            return owned

        result = dispatch_event({"kind": "get"}, {"get": handler})
        self.assertEqual(result, owned)
        self.assertIsNot(result, owned)
        self.assertIsNot(result["nested"], owned["nested"])
        owned["nested"].append(2)
        self.assertEqual(result, {"nested": [1]})
        result["nested"].append(3)
        self.assertEqual(owned, {"nested": [1, 2]})

    def test_event_and_handlers_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            dispatch_event([], {})
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            dispatch_event({"kind": "x"}, [])
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            dispatch_event({}, {})
        for kind in (None, 1, b"x"):
            with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
                dispatch_event({"kind": kind}, {})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dispatch_event({"kind": ""}, {})

    def test_missing_and_non_callable_handlers(self):
        with self.assertRaises(KeyError):
            dispatch_event({"kind": "missing"}, {})
        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            dispatch_event({"kind": "x"}, {"x": 42})

    def test_all_preconditions_are_checked_before_call(self):
        calls = []

        def handler(event):
            calls.append(event)

        with self.assertRaises(TypeError):
            dispatch_event({"kind": 1}, {1: handler})
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dispatch_event({"kind": ""}, {"": handler})
        self.assertEqual(calls, [])

    def test_handler_exception_propagates_without_second_call(self):
        count = [0]

        def handler(event):
            count[0] += 1
            raise RuntimeError("failure")

        with self.assertRaises(RuntimeError):
            dispatch_event({"kind": "x"}, {"x": handler})
        self.assertEqual(count[0], 1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
